notes.markdown:
Forwarding in chat, a default push-to-talk channel, easier MonoPhone sign-in for users, voicemail settings in the app,
better live captions, and subscriptions you can see and manage in one place.

## New

- **Chat: select and forward.** Select several messages and forward them to other chats or straight to a colleague,
  in MonoPhone and the console. Order and attachments are kept and each message shows "Forwarded". Live locations
  cannot be forwarded, because they belong to the person sharing them.
- **Push-to-talk channel "Everyone".** Every company gets a default push-to-talk channel with everyone who has an
  extension, joined automatically on their devices. People who join or leave the company join or leave the channel.
- **Push-to-talk channels in the console.** Create and manage channels and their members in Admin, Messaging,
  Push-to-talk.
- **Add the MonoPhone app from the extension page.** Send a sign-in link or show a QR code for the extension. No MAC
  address, no new device and no new SIP password are needed.
- **Voicemail settings in MonoPhone.** Calls, Voicemail now opens your greetings, voicemail PIN, e-mail delivery and
  transcription settings directly.
- **Favourites in your order.** Drag favourites into the order you want in People, Favourites. The order is shared
  with MonoPhone and your other devices.
- **Alert e-mails.** Toll-fraud, spending and MonoPbx Voice alerts can be e-mailed to administrators who opt in, in
  their own language, with a limit on how often they are sent.
- **Subscriptions and billing.** See your running subscriptions, renewals and payments in the console and the account
  portal. Prices shown include tax.
- **MonoPbx Voice.** Available when enabled by your provider. New permissions for the voice plan and for numbers, a
  switch to turn the service on or off, one payment card shared with your licence, and requests to bring your own
  numbers (number porting).
- **MonoPbx Cloud backups.** Cloud servers back up to cloud storage without any storage key on the server. An
  administrator can show the backup key to keep it safe.
- **MMS files.** Incoming MMS pictures can be received with a per-provider application key, and files sent over SMPP
  arrive as text with a download link that expires.
- **Liquid Glass on iOS 26.** MonoPhone uses the system's glass look for its tab bar and toolbars on iOS 26.
- **Google AI example.** The AI setup guide now shows how to use Gemini and Google Cloud Speech.

## Improved

- **Live captions** remember your language, start faster and recover more reliably after network changes.
- **Chat videos** start playing at once while they load, and round video notes can be turned into text.
- **Live location sharing** updates every 10 to 30 seconds, can be stopped from the Android notification, and stops
  when you sign out. The console shows a read-only card.
- **Sign-in links** show "Signing you in..." while the app or console finishes signing in.
- **MonoPhone design.** Me, the four tabs, call screens, people, messages and sign-in follow the new design more
  closely. Hints under settings are never cut off in long languages.
- **Colours.** Busy and Do not disturb are shown in amber, not red. Green and red are used only for calls and
  hanging up, in the app and the console.
- **SIP domains.** Each SIP account belongs to one domain, which is also its sign-in realm, so phones on your own SIP
  domain register cleanly.
- **AI assistant tools** can read more of your settings, and company-wide limits and confirmation steps protect
  changes.

## Fixed

- **Licence check after a restart.** A server that restarts no longer risks being reported as running on another
  server.
- **Language of system messages.** Security notices and announcements in Messages show in each reader's language.
- **Admin menu on foldable iPhones.** The Admin and Supervisor menu now lays out correctly on both screens and in
  every hinge position.

## Security

- Security fixes (high): sign-in protection for connected AI assistants was strengthened, and changes made through
  them now require the latest version of a setting. Update soon.
